create_Omniglot_dataset: create an Omniglot PyTorch dataset that downloads and indexes character images from the Omniglot repository
create_OmniglotNShot_loader: create an OmniglotNShot data loader for N-way K-shot few-shot learning with configurable batch size and image size
use_find_classes: use find_classes to recursively walk a directory and return a list of PNG image files with their category paths
use_index_classes: use index_classes to build a mapping from category names to integer class indices from a list of items
call_OmniglotNShot_next: call the next method on OmniglotNShot to get the next batch of support and query sets for training or testing
